adjudication.rationale: In the new webhook handler, the code does a non-atomic `findFirst` on `{ userId, appId: appMetadata.slug }` and then conditionally `create` (else branch) without a transaction or `upsert` (apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts, ~lines 60-85). This is a real concurrency risk: simultaneous webhook deliveries for the same pair could both observe “no row” and attempt `create`, which can either produce duplicates (if no DB uniqueness) or throw on a unique constraint (if one exists). The diff doesn’t show the Prisma schema, so the claim about “no unique constraint” / guaranteed duplicates can’t be fully verified, but the race condition concern is grounded in the diff.
